reviews.author: Julie Puuri
reviews.text: Steve and crew did an amazing job. Great attention to detail, and they went above and beyond the original scope of work. Very accommodating to our schedule and very respectful of our home while they were here. Cleaned up everything afterwards, did not leave any task incomplete. Highly recommend Paintworx; will definitely be using them again!

reviews.author: Ruritan National
reviews.text: Steve and his crew did an awesome job on exterior of our building. Professional, thorough and great attention to detail. Really appreciated their dedication to getting the work done on time -- even though the weather didn't always cooperate! Would definitely recommend PaintWorx!

reviews.author: Ayman Karim
reviews.text: Steve and his crew, and in particular Josh, were fantastic. They are detail oriented and check everything they do more than once. Steve is very honest and trustworthy and was very easy to work with. He was very accommodating to some changes in schedule because we had other work being done. I also enjoyed our chats. Overall I highly recommend him.

reviews.author: mona charney
reviews.text: Steve and his crew finished painting my home a few weeks ago. The results were awesome! The crew was polished and professional, and did a fantastic job. The price was excellent and the quality superb. The painters were attentive, careful and neat. Exceeded expectations.

reviews.author: Jeff Leedy
reviews.text: Steve and his crew did a great job painting the exterior of our one-story brick house. The price was reasonable and the painters were friendly and professional. I would recommend them to anyone looking for great work at a fair price.

reviews.author: Kyle and Maggie Hooper
reviews.text: Seemed like a great company to go with at first. I received an estimate, good value, and professional. When it came time to schedule, communication was poor, and I had to follow up multiple times. Steve scheduled a time to come back out and take a look at our home and never showed up. When asked about why he didn’t show up he just said he got busy that day and offered no apology. I’m sure the work they do is great, but with poor communication and a lack of professionalism, I decided to look elsewhere.

reviews.author: Ruth
reviews.text: Steve and his crew are wonderful. You can rely on their work completely. They are committed to providing the best value for your money, and are honest, dependable and thorough. No skimping. I hired them to paint my house interior and everyone comments that they did a great job. You can't go wrong hiring PaintWorx.

reviews.author: Frank Moseley
reviews.text: These men do awesome work!! They painted the exterior of our home. They are fast and efficient...no time wasted! And they are very neat and clean. It was a huge job...finished to perfection...and reasonably priced. I 100% recommend them for any of your paint jobs...you won't be sorry that you hired them. We will definitely use them again in the future!

reviews.author: Emily H
reviews.text: Steve and his crew painted the exterior of our brick house and they were THE best. Here's why: - They always showed up on time - The whole team was very friendly - They were patient, helpful, and knowledgeable about picking out colors (I had a hard time choosing. They never seemed annoyed with my indecisiveness and only wanted to make sure I was happy with the colors). - They were flexible and didn't mind changes to the project (We decided to have them paint all of the gutters and trim once the brick was painted and we could see how everything looked together). - They truly cared that we were happy with the work! (I caught Steve driving by the house one evening after hours. I was outside and he stopped and talked with me more and helped me to decide on colors) I would recommend PaintWorx to anyone who needs paint work done, especially if you want to paint your brick house!

reviews.author: jenny holman
reviews.text: We had our deck and bedroom painted and they did a great job. Polite crew, cleaned up after themselves, and got the job done very quickly once we were scheduled. Price was fair and we are very satisfied with the work!

reviews.author: Anthony Crotty
reviews.text: Steve, Josh and his crew did excellent job professionally done.. Cleaned up well everyday. Everything was as promised. We have a brick house they did the exterior so many people have stopped and told us how beautiful it is.. If you ever need someone to paint inside or outside please take my advice and call Steve.. Also very reasonably priced. Anthony Crotty

reviews.author: rob carter
reviews.text: BEWARE! This business is falling apart. Employees are leaving. The Owner is a liar. Promises work and does not honor promises. I have several people unhappy with shoddy quality work. Look elsewhere for a professional painter.

reviews.author: jacob mccall
reviews.text: These guys did a great job from top to bottom. Everything turned out exactly they way we wanted it to. Stained the entire house, trim, and decks all at a great price.

reviews.author: David Ravita
reviews.text: I got a quote and tried to set up appointment. Never got a call back and just ignored me through multiple attempts to get in touch. Ended up going with someone else.
